versions.subject: New rules + small mitre update

selection:
    Image|endswith: '\anydesk.exe'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '.dll'
        - '.exe'

condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*

versions.subject: Merge PR #5207 from @swachchhanda000 - Updated Anydesk related rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\AnyDesk.exe'
        - '\AnyDeskMSI.exe'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '.dll'
        - '.exe'
filter_dlls:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\gcapi.dll'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\AnyDesk.exe", "*\\AnyDeskMSI.exe") TargetFilename IN ("*.dll", "*.exe") NOT TargetFilename="*\\gcapi.dll"
